dataset.title: lobid-organisations — memory institutions in German-speaking countries

frozen_source.network_policy: The pinned local snapshot is the only permitted source. No network request, refresh, retry, range request, or reacquisition is authorized.

forbidden_examples: organisation names, types, status and classifications
contact, telephone, email and web data
field_access_contract.coordinate_use: The source coordinate may be emitted only as the coordinate of a strictly admitted Bavaria source-only address candidate. It may not select a benchmark row, validate itself, fill or replace an accepted row, or serve as evaluation truth.

transformation.scope: Outcome-blind Bavaria-only strict source-only feasibility from the pinned local lobid snapshot.
transformation.state_rule: Require rs to match exactly ^09[0-9]{10}$ and containment by exactly one pinned BKG Land geometry equal to DE-BY under its Polygon/MultiPolygon component rules; rs and BKG must agree. BKG containment proves Land only, not address accuracy.
transformation.address_rule: Reject C0/C1/DEL controls. Require country DE, one nonzero five-digit postcode, normalized nonempty locality, and a non-Postfach streetAddress matching exactly ^\s*(.+\S)\s+([0-9]+)\s*([A-Za-z]?)\s*$. Ranges, lists, fractions, unparsed tails and generic fuzzy normalization fail closed.
transformation.coordinate_rule: Require geo.lat and geo.lon to be strict no-whitespace, no-exponent decimal JSON strings; canonicalize with Decimal fixed-point semantics; require the Germany box and exactly one DE-BY polygon using the pinned 1e-10 boundary semantics. Axis guessing and coordinate repair are forbidden.
transformation.multiplicity_rule: Group by the exact normalized (street, locality, positive house number, lowercase optional suffix) identity with postcode as consistency metadata. Repeated ISILs and repeated semantic identities are rejected in full; exact coordinate reuse across different identities is quarantined. No first-candidate or row-order choice is allowed.
transformation.base_rule: Compare the exact four-field semantic identity against every row in the accepted component-matched BNetzA builder using its frozen 12-column header and extraction rules. Existing identities are excluded; postcode/locality-code conflicts are quarantined; accepted base rows and coordinates remain byte-for-byte preserved.
transformation.output_rule: The feasibility run may persist only one additive, write-once aggregate receipt and public-source dictionary commitments. Literal addresses, coordinates, source identifiers and candidate rows remain volatile. Commitments provide integrity, not confidentiality. It may not build an index, run an engine, calculate a product metric, or promote data.

quality_caveat: lobid location coordinates describe memory institutions and their coordinate-production lineage is not proven to be authoritative building-centroid geometry. Passing the offline feasibility gate is therefore only permission to design a separate one-shot development treatment; it is not evidence of positional quality or permission to ship.
relationship_to_prior_source_card: This card is additive and narrowly authorizes coordinate access for a Bavaria-only offline feasibility experiment. It does not modify or supersede code/prep/de_isil_lobid_source_v1.json, whose postcode-overlay field restrictions remain binding for that treatment.
